contract.rules:
If the increase in total non-farm payroll employment is above 30000 as reported by the Bureau of Labor Statistics Monthly Employment Situation Report for the month of October 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.

The market closes at 8:29 AM ET on the expected date of the data release.
